_about: Numbers plan.py enforces. Each one is a ruling (source in brackets). Change a number only on Colden's word and bump RULES in common.py.
_window: [Colden 2026-10-03] live show Thursday, run Thursday night, posting Friday to the following Thursday, repeat. Fri-Thu is only the DEFAULT proposal: "I think it would be best to ask for a time span first then develop your cadence around that and the currently scheduled clips, rather than just assume and move on" (window.py)
_min_lead: [aggregator] no slot sooner than this after the plan is built: review on Telegram takes time; a slot that has passed by approval time is a rebuild, never a silent shift
_clip_time: [Colden 2026-10-03] "For clip timings it might be best to pull fresh data from YouTube before determining": cal.py peaks reads Studio's 'When your viewers are on YouTube' card per channel (youtube-packaging step 10: publish 15-30 min before the day's peak). 14:00 (CWC_PodClips hand-off) only for a channel whose card has no data, flagged on the card
_secondary: [CWC_PodClips ruling 3 + Colden 2026-10-03] the same clip on both: CWC first, TCL any time >= 48 h later. A TCL-only clip has NO delay ("If only going to TCL, no delay needed")
_short_secondary: [Colden 2026-10-03] "CWC always gets a 48 hr priority over TCL shorts if the same reel goes out on both". A TCL-only short has no delay
_spill: [aggregator] a TCL post pushed past the window by a 48 h rule (clip or short) may land up to this many days after it (flagged on the card); more = ask
_shorts: [CWC_PodReels publishing.cadence] one a day per brand, extras as second posts on the busiest days >= 3 h apart
_same_topic: [CWC_PodClips aggregator_handoff] no short on top of the clip of the same topic; no two products of the same topic on one channel on one day. Same topic = the two share >= this many seconds of the locked cut
_audit: [Colden 2026-10-03] "Skill uploads to YouTube and adds in all the metadata. I flip from private to scheduled based on the dashboard." Until the audit passes: every video goes up through the API, private, no publishAt; the dashboard shows each flip time. After it (his word flips this to true): publishAt is set at upload.
_quota: YouTube Data API units, one project-wide pool shared with CWC_PodClips (data/quota.json, day = Pacific). Verify the costs against Google's quota calculator once; videos.insert is the expensive one.
_counts: [Colden 2026-10-03] the 20-post limit starts over on the 1st of each month; Metricool's API lists only posts not yet published, so the month count comes from a Claude in Chrome screenshot of the Metricool calendar (or Colden's number) - cal.py counts
_ig_collab: Instagram's collaborator limit per post - verify the current number; a reel with more speakers than this asks
_collab: [Colden 2026-10-03] Instagram collaborators = who speaks in the reel: "If only colden talks in a clip. no collab, if guest + colden talk then guest gets added as a collab. Jake and Todd can both be added as collabs as well if they speak in the reel. Each reel only gets ONE set of collaborators... Collabs get priority on Colden's channel if the reel plays on both. If the reel only plays on TCL, add collaborators there." Speaking = a phrase of >= this many words in the reel (a 'yeah' / 'right' backchannel is not speaking - the same line CWC_PodReels draws for captions); to confirm with Colden
